answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the river of a task receipt, and the falcon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
